title: Wire engine/fear.py react() into live turns and fix frightened self-defense and cowardly trigger timing

sections.what: Wire engine/fear.py (react / release_absent_fears) into live interactive turns and tick processing, allow cornered self-defense under frightened_block in combat.py, and give traits.cowardly a pre-damage witness/threat trigger.
sections.why: engine/fear.py (apply_frightening, release_absent_fears, react) is only called from background_social.py, timeskip.py, and soak.py - never during live interactive play or tick_manager.py ticks. Meanwhile engine/combat.py (lines 258-264) blocks attacking a feared source even when cornered or grappled in self-defense, and traits.cowardly (engine/traits.py) listens only on 'takes_damage' (activities.py:547-550) with no behavior_prompt or witness-danger trigger.
sections.how: 1. Invoke fear.react() (apply_frightening and release_absent_fears) in live area transitions and engine/tick_manager.py turn/tick processing (reusing the same helper already called by soak/timeskip/background_social) so fear_tags apply and clear cleanly during live turns.\n2. Update frightened_block usage in engine/combat.py (lines 258-264) and engine/conditions.py (lines 121-145) so when the feared character is actively grappling or recently attacked by that target (or cannot flee), self-defense proceeds at the frightening attack_mod penalty rather than leaving the defender helpless.\n3. Add pre-damage fear trigger (e.g. threat/combat witness save_on hook) and behavior_prompt to traits.py ('cowardly', where currently only 'takes_damage' triggers) so cowardly characters react to imminent violence, not solely after taking HP damage.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering engine/fear.py, engine/conditions.py, engine/traits.py, and live turn execution in VirtualWorld verifying fear_tags apply in interactive play.\n2. Test that a frightened character actively attacked/grappled by their fear source can retaliate/defend while frightened attack_mod penalties still apply, and test cowardly pre-damage save triggers.

acceptance.text: Live /api/action and engine/tick_manager.py execution invokes engine/fear.react() / release_absent_fears() on arrival and turn advance so fear_tags triggers function in interactive play, not only in soak/timeskip.

frightened_block in engine/conditions.py / combat.py allows a cornered or actively attacked/grappled character to defend themselves (with disadvantage/penalty) rather than unconditionally blocking self-defense against their attacker.
cowardly trait in engine/traits.py defines pre-damage witness/threat save_on hooks (beyond takes_damage alone) and behavior_prompt guidance.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal (active 'frightened' condition badge on character status) and Event Stream turn log.

Current availability: engine/fear.py and traits.cowardly exist but react() is never invoked during live turn resolution in routes/action_handlers.py or tick_manager.py.

Manual verification steps:
1. Place a character with fear_tags or cowardly trait in an area where a matching threat enters or attacks.
2. Advance one turn or move into the room and inspect the character's conditions and combat response.
   - expected: fear.react() fires the fear condition automatically on exposure, cowardly characters save on witnessed danger as well as damage, and a frightened character being attacked or grappled can still attempt desperate self-defense.
